reviewed_ranges.purpose: A named requirement resolved from a local flat index uses RegistryBuiltWheel.
A registry dist remains a CachedDist::Registry; this is distinct from a direct filesystem wheel argument.
Cached Registry dist has no parsed direct URL.
The original installer passes only parsed_url as direct_url; no parsed URL means no direct_url argument.
The original site package parser identifies a dist without direct_url.json as Registry.
Strict registry satisfaction requires Registry installed kind and specifier/version match; source index is not compared here.
Already-installed Satisfied case continues before remote cache/download planning.
Frozen lock resolution and strict original install flow; no virtual project installation.

limitations: No native invocation, uv command, download, installation or source gate was performed for this source review.
Source semantics establish the intended execution path; the actual external environment must pass the original frozen/offline sync check.

The registry installed-kind check is not a cryptographic attestation of already-installed files; the driver must independently verify the exact wheel artifact before bootstrap, isolate the environment, and preserve bootstrap/metadata/version outputs.
An explicit wheel pathname or wheel URL as the requirement is a different Dist variant and must not replace the named requirement.
